title: Gatefold run audit result
description: Machine-readable evidence audit emitted by gatefold audit-run --format json. Version 8 audits one yuurei run directory's stored records: each fact reports a state (verified, inconsistent, unverifiable, not-recorded) and a completeness (complete, partial, unknown) with evidence references into the run's bounded inputs and any supplied external check reports. This is a factual verification report — no task-quality judgement, no rubric verdicts, no aggregate score, and no claim about runtime behavior.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema. Additive changes keep the version; structural changes bump it.

source.description: Identifies this result as a single-run audit.

inputs.description: Descriptors of the audited run directory and each supplied external check report.

context.description: Observed run context preserved separately from the facts; descriptive, never a score.

facts.description: The fixed audit fact list in contract order (docs/v0.8-scope.md), followed by the per-report check-report.* facts for each supplied report in argument order.

label.description: The input argument as supplied, or '<stdin>'.

schemaVersion.description: The trace's schema_version compatibility token, compared for equality (currently '0.3').

yuureiVersion.description: yuurei_version of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

runtimeVersion.description: runtime.version of the trace; null is preserved as null.

modelResolved.description: model.resolved of the trace; null means the effective model was not observed.

modelResolvedReason.description: model.resolved_reason of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

requestedCellDigest.description: requested_cell.digest of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

requestedCellInputsVersion.description: requested_cell.inputs_version of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

executionOptions.description: The trace's execution_options value recorded verbatim; absent when the trace does not carry it.

definition.description: The trace's definition value recorded verbatim ({ run: string | null, cli_overrides: string[] }); absent when the trace does not carry it.

artifactEntry.description: One artifact manifest entry preserved verbatim plus Gatefold's verification outcome.

path.description: The manifest-recorded path, relative to the run directory. Treated as data, never as an access instruction.

digest.description: The manifest-recorded digest of the stored bytes (sha256:<hex> when verifiable).

truncated.description: Present and true only when the manifest marks the stored bytes as cut at yuurei's size cap. The digest covers the stored (cut) bytes.

bytes.description: Stored byte count when the file was examined; absent when the artifact was not read.

state.description: Verification outcome: the stored bytes hash to the recorded digest (verified, or verified-truncated when also marked truncated), they do not (digest-mismatch), no readable file exists at the path (missing), or the bytes were not read or not verifiable in this milestone (unverified).

evalRunInput.description: Descriptor of the audited yuurei run directory: the supplied label, the trace descriptor, seeded provenance, the patch and final-result summary states, and the manifest facts.

label.description: The run directory argument as supplied.

seeded.description: Whether the trace records seeded-workspace provenance (a seed field).

baseline.description: The recorded seeded baseline identity (trace.seed.baseline), or null for a legacy empty-workspace run.

materializedDigest.description: The materialized baseline digest the pre-runtime verification recomputed; identical to digest on any shipped seeded run.

source.description: The seed tree's source path; provenance only, never part of identity.

head.description: The source repository's HEAD commit at seed resolution; provenance only.

changes.description: The recorded change-set counts (trace.seed.changes), or null when the trace records no change set — absence never means no changes.

patchRecord.description: The trace's patch completeness record (trace.patch), or null on traces that predate it. A verified digest proves stored bytes match the manifest; only state 'complete' certifies the patch covers the full change set.

base.description: Which workspace the patch diffs against.

state.description: complete = the stored diff describes every recorded change; partial = it may omit files (redaction, truncation, binary/oversized/unrepresentable content, or the total cap); absent = patch generation did not succeed.

patchState.description: The state of the run's patch.diff: the manifest entry's state when listed, 'malformed' when verified bytes violate the patch grammar, or 'not-recorded' when the manifest lists no patch entry.

resultState.description: The state of the run's result.txt: the manifest entry's state when listed, 'not-emitted'/'parse-failed'/'save-failed' from the trace's result diagnostics, or 'not-recorded' when nothing records a result.

checkReportInput.description: Descriptor of one supplied external check report. The audit reports whether the document parses and whether its declared subject digests match the run's recorded identity; a matching declaration never attests that the evaluator ran on those bytes.

label.description: The check-report file argument as supplied.

evaluatorId.description: Identity of the evaluator/test runner that produced the report; null when the report could not be parsed.

evaluatorVersion.description: Version of the evaluator when the report records one; absent otherwise.

state.description: Whether the supplied document is a conforming v1 check report. Whether its declared digests match the run is reported per-fact, not here.

error.description: Why the report did not parse; present only when state is 'invalid'.

resultCount.description: Number of result rows the report carried (0 for an unparsed report).

runContext.description: Observed run context: execution status, model identity, usage, and cost — descriptive only, never a score.

exitCode.description: execution.exit_code of the trace; describes process termination, not answer quality.

resolved.description: model.resolved of the trace; null means the effective model was not observed.

resolvedReason.description: model.resolved_reason of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

usage.description: The trace's usage record verbatim; a key absent means never attempted, null means attempted but unobserved.

cost.description: The trace's cost estimate; null means no estimate was produced.

id.description: The stable fact identifier from docs/v0.8-scope.md (e.g. 'patch.stored', 'changes.record', 'check-report.task-binding').

subject.description: Present only on check-report.* facts: the label of the supplied report the fact is about.

state.description: verified: the records affirmatively establish the fact. inconsistent: two well-formed records contradict each other, or verified bytes violate their documented shape. unverifiable: the needed record is missing, mismatched, truncated, or uninterpretable. not-recorded: the record the fact audits was never produced.

completeness.description: How complete the evidence behind the fact is — separate from state: a verified stored-byte digest on a truncated or declared-partial record is 'partial', never 'complete'.

reason.description: Why the state is what it is — including why a fact is unverifiable or not-recorded.

evidence.description: References into the run's documents and any supplied reports that support the fact's state. Both agreeing and contradicting records are cited.

source.description: Which document the reference resolves against: the run's trace.json or artifacts.json, its verified patch.diff/result.txt bytes (cited by manifest pointer), the verified baseline-manifest.json/changes.json documents, or a supplied external check report.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the document named by source. For the patch and result sources it is the manifest pointer of that artifact entry; for baselineManifest and changes it resolves inside the verified record document. The empty string references the whole document.

digest.description: Artifact and supplemental-record evidence only: the manifest-recorded digest of the verified stored bytes the reference locates into.

path.description: Patch evidence only: the workspace-relative file path whose block the range locates inside the stored patch bytes.

lines.description: Artifact evidence only: an inclusive 1-based line range inside the verified stored bytes.

bytes.description: Artifact evidence only: a half-open 0-based byte range inside the verified stored bytes.

elementId.description: For check-report evidence, the label of the supplying report; otherwise unused.

note.description: Optional human-readable clarification of what the reference shows.

range.description: An inclusive 1-based line range or a half-open 0-based byte range into verified stored bytes.

provenance.description: Per-input metadata (labels, descriptors) lives in the top-level inputs map.

transform.description: Names of the transformations applied between the raw inputs and this fact, in application order.
